Integra AI

B2B AI Consultancy Landing Page

About the Project

Integra AI is a B2B landing page for an AI consultancy focused on agents, CRM/ERP integrations, MLOps, and AI strategy. The site turns a complex technical offer into a clear commercial experience, guiding visitors from business pain points to services, process, team credibility, proof points, and contact.

Implementation Focus

My focus was shaping the UX narrative and frontend execution: building a sharp hero, service structure, process section, team storytelling, responsive layouts, animated canvas ribbon, bilingual navigation, and contact flow. The goal was to make enterprise AI feel concrete, understandable, and conversion-ready.

SAT Redesign

UX Redesign

About the Project

SAT Redesign is a UX case study focused on reducing friction in two high-stress government service flows: getting an RFC and scheduling an appointment. The redesign was grounded in user journeys, interviews, and pain-point mapping.

Implementation Focus

The work focused on simplifying decision points, clarifying next steps, and restructuring the experience around user intent instead of institutional complexity. The output prioritized clearer information architecture, lower cognitive load, and more predictable flows.

Wellty

Identity-Based Wellness App

About the Project

Wellty is a wellness app that reframes self-care around identity instead of metrics. Rather than starting with dashboards, the experience asks who the user wants to be that day and turns that intention into short, actionable habits.

Implementation Focus

The product focus was designing a behavior loop that feels lightweight but meaningful: identity selection, 2-minute actions, XP feedback, and progress across the seven dimensions of wellness. I designed and built the SwiftUI experience with local persistence.
